name: Far-infrared BIB detector dark and illuminated response, 5–20 K
plain_name: Far-infrared BIB detector dark and illuminated response, 5–20 K
description: Characterize a far-infrared blocked-impurity-band detector using the DRS reported cold-shutter and optical-port method, relevant to cooled sensing technology.

sources.citation: DRS, Far-Infrared Blocked Impurity Band Detector Development

requirements.rationale: The detector stage is controlled across 5–20 K.
A cold shutter provides the dark-reference state.

missing_information: Spectral band, optical background, detector bias, absolute radiometry and calibrated responsivity/noise are source- and detector-specific; none are fabricated as a pass condition.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
